# Test data

`formats/` and `schema-catalog/` contain serialized examples shared by the scene, reflection,
and reference-game tests. `images/` contains small PNGs used to test asset loading. Keep these
inputs with the behavior they exercise until the Phase 5 format cutover retires them.

The `legacy/v0-imgui-reference` tag contains the retired compatibility and boundary workspaces,
including the Dialogue Graph prototype under `tests/fixtures/gpui-engine-consumer/`. Use
[`reference-game`](../../reference-game/README.md) and
[`samples/two-level-game`](../../samples/two-level-game/README.md) for complete game workflows.
